about.title: About
about.about1: Based in Lyon, French model represented by Enjoy Models and Hourra Models.
about.about2a: Passionate about the world of creation.
about.about2b: Driven by ambition and a constant thirst for growth.
about.about3: Every experience is an opportunity to go further, to push her limits and to fully explore the extent of her potential.
about.about4: Creativity also comes through music, which holds an essential place in my life.
about.about5: Singing is the main source that drives my passions: pop, R&B, French variété and learning the piano. I love giving a voice to my inspirations.
